runners_data.name: Pursuit Of Love
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with class edge, William Buick booking suggests confidence after 56-day break following impressive debut win

runners_data.name: Quiet Summer
runners_data.note: Complete unknown after lightly raced career, Andrew Balding stable in good form but going preference unclear

runners_data.name: Ravenspire
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who won on debut, 45-day gap ideal and Pierre-Louis Jamin knows the Burke string well

runners_data.name: Poker
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 180-day layoff, poor recent form but distance increase might help

races.paceDynamic: Ravenspire will lead from the gates with no other confirmed pace angle in this small field of four. Pursuit Of Love and Poker both show prominent tendencies but are unlikely to challenge Ravenspire's early supremacy, allowing the leader to dictate fractions. With Quiet Summer an unknown quantity but likely to settle further back, this sets up a controlled gallop where the front runner can string the field out. This race shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can track the pace, as there's insufficient early pressure to compromise Ravenspire's position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ravenspire Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Ravenspire gets an uncontested lead and maintains steady fractions
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate ideal splits and kick for home when ready, making use of the flat track's demands for sustained speed. Front running horses with tactical speed hold all the aces when unopposed early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Pursuit Of Love or Poker can sit close and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The Charlie Appleby-trained Pursuit Of Love has the class edge and William Buick's tactical nous to track and pounce late. Prominent racers benefit when they can conserve energy behind a steady pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Quiet Summer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the unknown Quiet Summer shows unexpected early pace or finishing kick
scenarios.body: Andrew Balding's lightly raced runner could have hidden ability and tactical versatility that catches the others napping. Unknown quantities sometimes thrive in small fields where race dynamics are predictable.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Poker Gamble Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Poker bounces back from poor recent form and settles better over this longer trip
scenarios.body: The 180-day break might have freshened Karl Burke's runner, and the step up in distance could suit better than recent shorter efforts. Sometimes long absences mask improvement work.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Ravenspire gets harried early by Pursuit Of Love or Poker, as the leader needs to control the tempo to maximize winning chances
Monitor Quiet Summer's early positioning as any unexpected pace injection could disrupt the predicted race flow
Check Poker's early enthusiasm after the long break, as rustiness or over-eagerness could compromise tactical positioning
Observe if Pursuit Of Love tracks closer than expected, as Buick may have instructions to apply more early pressure than usual

races.paceDynamic: Henlein is the lone confirmed front runner and will get an uncontested lead through the early stages at his own comfortable tempo. With most runners preferring prominent or hold-up positions, the pace will be moderate early before quickening from the 3f pole as the prominent runners like Cosi Bello, Khafiz, and Great Acclaim move into contention. The lack of early pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint finish with horses coming from all angles in the final two furlongs. This moderate-to-strong pace scenario clearly favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks who can capitalize on the inevitable late gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Henlein maintains his early advantage without serious pace pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: The German-bred gets first run on his rivals turning for home and proves hard to peg back despite carrying top weight. His proven stamina at the trip and lack of early harassment allows him to find enough in reserve when the closers come calling.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Specialists Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace allows the back markers to unleash their finishing kicks effectively
scenarios.body: The Angel King, Marshman and Caburn get the perfect setup to showcase their closing speed from the rear of the field. Their ability to quicken off a steady gallop proves decisive as they sweep past the prominent racers in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners like Cosi Bello and Khafiz can position perfectly behind Henlein without using up energy
scenarios.body: These horses get the ideal trip tracking the leader before moving smoothly into contention at the 2f marker. Their tactical speed and race fitness allows them to surge clear of both the leader and the hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Finish Required
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling early and turns into a pure sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of pure acceleration rather than stamina, favouring those with electric finishing speed regardless of position. Horses with proven turn-of-foot thrive in this scenario while stamina types struggle.

watchPoints.text: Henlein faces the starter for first time in 420 days and must prove his fitness against these competitive handicappers
The Angel King's 72-day break could blunt his finishing kick despite Egan's valuable claim and recent course success
Cosi Bello returns from nearly nine-month layoff but Fellowes has excellent record with returning horses on good ground
Korker's recent tendency to fade in the final furlong makes him vulnerable despite his hold-up running style suiting the pace
Great Acclaim has been consistently placed recently and the step back up to 7f should suit his prominent racing style perfectly

races.paceDynamic: Ted Le Saux will lead from the gates with no obvious pace rival, but five horses (Winter Flower, Due To Henry, Jujubella, Empire Of Light, Roarin' Success) all want prominent positions creating inevitable traffic problems. The front half will be congested early as these prominent runners jostle for position behind Ted Le Saux's sustainable gallop. This creates a stop-start rhythm that will compromise those caught wide or shuffled back, while the hold-up horses (Cancelled, Cavolo Nero, Naples) get an ideal setup to pick up the pieces from the back. This pace dynamic strongly favours hold-up horses who can find clear runs late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners clash for position behind Ted Le Saux in the first half mile
scenarios.body: The pace becomes messy and compromised, allowing the back markers to sweep up with late runs through gaps. Hold-up specialists get the perfect scenario with a strong gallop to aim at but no early pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Ted Le Saux wires field
scenarios.trigger: If Ted Le Saux gets an easy lead with the prominent pack settling kindly behind
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage as the chasers mark each other, with his sustainable pace proving just enough. William Buick can dictate terms from the front without serious challenge until too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runner prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses (Winter Flower/Empire Of Light) secures the ideal tracking position
scenarios.body: They get first run on Ted Le Saux turning for home and have enough class to hold off the late challengers. The winner comes from those who avoid the early scrimmaging but stay close enough.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits closer
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong with the prominent runners going too hard
scenarios.body: The leaders come back dramatically in the final furlong, allowing a patient ride from midfield to pick up the pieces. The winner needs to be held up but not too far back.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Winter Flower and Empire Of Light both going for the same prominent position early - could compromise both horses
Ted Le Saux might get too easy a lead if the prominent pack gets tangled up behind him
Cavolo Nero and Cancelled both need clear runs late - watch for traffic problems if the field bunches up
Due To Henry's 187-day break makes him a pace risk who might not handle early pressure
Watch Pierre-Louis Jamin's positioning on Jujubella - needs to avoid getting shuffled back in the prominent scrum

races.paceDynamic: See Blue, Spiritoftheblues and Electrical will set a strong gallop from the off, with See Blue likely to take them along given his consistent front-running style and recent wins. This creates a pace collapse scenario where Go Rimbaud, Commanding Officer, Mr Seagull and Gold Dawn will be fighting for prominent positions behind the leaders, causing potential traffic problems turning for home. The sustained gallop over this stiff Haydock mile will set up perfectly for hold-up horses like Strength Of Spirit to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favours the closer who can avoid the early pace battle and benefit from the strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a fierce gallop through halfway with prominent runners crowding behind them.
scenarios.body: The pace will tell in the final 2f as leaders tire and traffic problems emerge from the pack. Strength Of Spirit can sweep past tired horses while any prominent runner avoiding trouble benefits from the collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If See Blue or Spiritoftheblues gets an easy lead with the other pace-setters not firing.
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear turning for home while the field struggles to close the gap having not pressured the pace enough. Recent form and fitness gives the front-runner enough stamina to hold on.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If Go Rimbaud or Commanding Officer secure ideal positions just behind the leaders without getting caught in traffic.
scenarios.body: They can strike turning for home before the hold-up horses get organized while having enough in reserve from tracking the pace rather than setting it. Class and jockey strength proves decisive in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Chaos Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If early pace is messy with leaders going too slow or prominent runners interfering with each other.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any horse with a clear passage can win regardless of running style. Form and luck in running becomes more important than tactical positioning.

Commanding Officer and Mr Seagull both return from 200+ day breaks carrying big weights in competitive handicap

races.paceDynamic: G'Emmethegreenlite, Houndhill, and Call Me By My Name will ensure a strong gallop from the gates in this 6f handicap. With three confirmed front runners and several prominent racers like Whiskey Kisses, Black Endeavour, and Paranjape likely to track close, the early pace will be genuine and sustained. The combination of Good to Firm ground and competitive pace will test stamina reserves in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the pace-setters will soften each other up for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If all three leaders G'Emmethegreenlite, Houndhill, and Call Me By My Name go too fast early
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will drain the front runners and prominent racers, creating perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade. Late-running types like Adalida and Jenny Jerome can exploit the pace collapse with perfectly timed challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If two of the three leaders engage in a sustained battle while the third drops back
scenarios.body: G'Emmethegreenlite and Houndhill could get locked in combat, allowing prominent racers to strike. Black Endeavour and Paranjape are best positioned to capitalize on this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front runners manages to steal a march and dictate a more conservative tempo
scenarios.body: Houndhill or G'Emmethegreenlite could break clear early and control the race from the front. The lack of early pressure would favor their stamina and make them hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactics Win
scenarios.trigger: If the mid-division horses avoid the early pace battle and position perfectly
scenarios.body: Whiskey Kisses and John Barleycorn could track the leaders without getting involved in early speed duels. Their tactical positioning would allow them to strike when the pace begins to tell on others.

races.paceDynamic: Punchbowl Flyer will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, with Cherry Cobbler and Harry Mole the only prominent racers likely to track close behind. This creates a moderate tempo without early pressure, allowing the leader to dictate fractions through the first half. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop, but with such a sustainable early gallop, they may struggle to make up ground in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the early positioned horses who can secure good tactical positions and avoid the traffic that will inevitably develop behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Running Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Punchbowl Flyer gets an uncontested lead and Cherry Cobbler tracks kindly in second
scenarios.body: The leader controls the tempo completely and kicks clear turning for home, while the prominent runners pick up the pieces. The hold-up brigade are caught flat-footed by the sustained tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Pays
scenarios.trigger: If Cherry Cobbler or Harry Mole apply early pressure to Punchbowl Flyer
scenarios.body: The increased tempo softens up the leader and creates a more genuine gallop that allows the better hold-up horses with pace to strike. Those tracking the speed inherit perfect positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and becomes a crawl
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole where class and finishing kick matter most. The best hold-up horses with proven pace get their ideal scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Tactical Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Punchbowl Flyer misses the break or gets headed early by an unlikely pace-setter
scenarios.body: The race develops into a messy affair with no clear tempo, creating opportunities for outsiders with tactical speed. Jockey judgement becomes crucial in the positioning battle.

The hold-up majority creating severe traffic problems for any horse drawn towards the inside
